nome_jp: ドラゴンフレンド・カチュア
testo:
■ When you put this creature into the battle zone, look at the top 7 cards of your deck. From among them, you may put a non-evolution Dragon Hunter creature that costs 7 or less into the battle zone. Then shuffle your deck. That creature gets "speed attacker" until the end of the turn. At the end of the turn, destroy that creature.
Hunting
